Come and Experience Toronto From Above This tour takes place at 2,000 feet and at speed averaging 100 miles per hour. It is amazing what you can see from above. Book Now Come and Experience Toronto From Above Our pilots will provide you with a longer dynamic flight, taking you to new heights over the Toronto Skyscrapers.
